rLinkBodyText:
Hello Tom

1 of 9 recorded

START RECORDING — COULD I HAVE IT TO TAKE AWAY?
Tap Start and read the line aloud. It is already recording.
Stop talking and it moves on by itself — you do not have to tap anything.
Tap Again to re-read a line, Next to push on early.
Tap Stop here when you've had enough. It saves itself.
Move on by itself when I stop speaking
On = just read, and keep reading. Turn it off in a noisy room and use Next instead.
Record the raw microphone
Off = the phone cleans up the sound as it records, the way a voice note does. Turn it on only to capture the room exactly as it is — it will sound quieter and rougher.
Re-read lines I've already recorded
Off = only read the lines that still need a recording. New takes replace old ones; nothing is deleted.
